title: From Numbers to Judgment: Specialist LLM Agents and Reinforcement Learning for European Listed Real Estate
abstract: arXiv:2608.11381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether the localized numerical operations and integrative judgments of financial analysis benefit from the same form of LLM specialization. Larix maps a 16-lens European listed-real-estate analysis framework to eight lens-aligned specialists; we compare a frontier LLM under monolithic versus specialist-decomposed prompting while holding the model, source evidence, task instructions, output schema, and scoring fixed. Across 19 firms spanning seven regulatory wrappers, decomposition improves the numerical-task aggregate by 15.8 percentage points but does not reliably improve, and can reduce, performance on judgment tasks, a pattern stable across four frozen-template dispatches; a single-agent control given the complete framework does not reproduce the numerical gain. Post-training Qwen3.5-9B with GRPO using task-aligned structured rewards then raises the development-split score by 12.0 points and the judgment aggregate by 14.2 po

translated_title: 从数字到判断：面向欧洲上市房地产的专家LLM智能体与强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11381v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究了金融分析中的局部数值运算和整合性判断是否受益于相同形式的LLM专业化。Larix将一个16视角的欧洲上市房地产分析框架映射到八个与视角对齐的专家上；我们在保持模型、源证据、任务指令、输出模式和评分固定的情况下，比较了前沿LLM在整体式提示与专家分解式提示下的表现。跨越七个监管框架覆盖的19家公司，分解式方法将数值任务总分提高了15.8个百分点，但在判断任务上并未可靠地提升，甚至可能降低表现，这一模式在四次固定模板调度中保持稳定；一个获得完整框架的单一智能体对照组未能复现数值增益。使用任务对齐的结构化奖励对Qwen3.5-9B进行GRPO后训练，将开发集分数提高了12.0分，判断总分提高了14.2分。
tldr: 本文提出Larix框架，通过将金融分析分解为八个专家LLM智能体，显著提升数值任务表现，但判断任务未获一致改善，并通过GRPO强化学习进一步优化模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Larix framework, which decomposes financial analysis into eight specialist LLM agents, significantly improving numerical task performance while judgment tasks show inconsistent gains, and further enhances model performance via GRPO reinforcement learning.
